messages.content: Help me change the current schema to 'AnalyticsDB' in the Exasol execution context while monitoring the progress with a monitor object named 'progressMonitor'?

function.name: ExasolExecutionContext_setCurrentSchema
function.description: Sets the current schema for the Exasol execution context to the specified schema name, and monitors the progress of this operation. Note that the provided function is in Java 8 SDK syntax.

monitor.description: The progress monitor to track the execution of setting the current schema. This parameter can be of any type of Java object in string representation.

schemaName.description: The name of the schema to set as the current schema. This is Java String type parameter in string representation.
